title: Poisson approximation by coupling
abstract: It is well known that a binomial $(n,p)$ can be approximated by a Poisson distribution with parameter $np$. The typical approach in undergraduate probability texts is to show a convergence result for the distribution of the binomial as $n$ goes to infinity and $np$ converges to some $λ$. In this note we use instead the coupling technique to show a much more general result. Moreover, we only use elementary results from probability.
